title: Cover Design gate and contract failure paths
correctionCommitMessage: test: cover Design gate contract failures
rootCause: Add direct meaningful quality evidence for the implemented Design gate and contract failure paths.

owner: DesignAgentService.validateInput for Design generation and selection
affectedGate.stage: Approved Brief and accepted Planning validation before Design provider/persistence side effects, followed by explicit selection and current Contract Audit/task-graph validation before implementation start
affectedGate.trustBoundary: Factory Design Agent input gate and downstream implementation-start boundary

designEvidenceBefore.implementedBehavior: The Design gate already rejected stale Brief and Planning checksums, invalid workflow state, missing Architecture Review, and unapproved requirement changes before provider or persistence side effects.
designEvidenceBefore.directEvidenceGap: The focused Design tests covered successful generation, exact-three readiness, selection, currentness, restart, and several business outcomes, but did not directly exercise those five input-contract failure modes through DesignAgentService.generateDesignDirections.
designEvidenceBefore.baselineTargetedTest: PASS; 16 tests in src/agents/design/design.test.ts, with the assigned contract-boundary evidence gap reproduced.

directFailureEvidence: Stale approved Brief checksum returns DESIGN_BRIEF_STALE before provider or persistence side effects.
Stale accepted Planning checksum returns DESIGN_PLANNING_STALE before provider or persistence side effects.
READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION supplied to generation returns DESIGN_WORKFLOW_STATE_INVALID.
Missing current Architecture Review returns DESIGN_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
A pending unapproved requirement change returns UNAPPROVED_REQUIREMENT_CHANGE.
designEvidenceAfter.sideEffectAssertions: Each scenario asserts zero provider calls, no persisted design-directions document, and no Project Memory design-directions projection.

designSetIdentity.identityEvidence: Existing deterministic Design tests assert exactly three meaningfully different directions, deterministic set/direction checksums, current set membership, and explicit selection; cg17 adds the missing input-contract failure assertions.

selection.selectedDirection: Must be a member of the current persisted set and carry the current direction checksum; selection is explicit user input.
selection.noSelectionBehavior: The workflow remains AWAITING_DESIGN_SELECTION and cannot cross to READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION.

currentnessRules.briefOrPlanningChange: Brief and Planning checksums are compared to the current persisted documents or their approved/accepted checksum; stale input is rejected before provider/persistence side effects.
currentnessRules.architectureReview: A current APPROVED Architecture Review must bind the current Brief and Planning checksums.
currentnessRules.designSetRegeneration: Regeneration supersedes the prior set, reopens READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION to AWAITING_DESIGN_SELECTION, deletes the selected design, and requires a new explicit selection.
currentnessRules.selectedDirection: Direction-set membership, set checksum, selected direction checksum, project/version, and row version are validated before selection authority changes.
currentnessRules.projectVersion: Wrong or stale project/version identity is rejected; the implementation-start boundary also binds Brief, Planning, selected Design, Contract Audit, and TaskGraph checksums.
currentnessRules.unrelatedCacheOrAdmin: No unrelated cache, QA history, admin document, schema, or migration currentness behavior was changed.

persistenceAuthority.canonicalAuthority: Database-backed DesignRepository and DocumentRepository records are authoritative for direction sets and selected design.
persistenceAuthority.projectMemoryRole: Project Memory receives a projection/snapshot for restart and context continuity; it is not the Design authority.
persistenceAuthority.workflowBehavior: Explicit selection persists selected-design, records the decision, and transitions AWAITING_DESIGN_SELECTION to READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION.

workflowAndImplementationStart.designGeneration: DesignAgentService validates input before provider calls and before design-direction persistence.
workflowAndImplementationStart.designSelection: Only a current persisted set and a user-selected current member can transition the project to READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION.
workflowAndImplementationStart.startImplementation: OrchestratorService requires READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION, a current approved Contract Audit bound to Brief/Planning/Design/TaskGraph checksums, and a ready graph before transitioning to IMPLEMENTING.

failureBehaviorMatrix.missingOrStaleBrief: DESIGN_BRIEF_STALE; no provider or durable/projection side effect.
failureBehaviorMatrix.missingOrStalePlanning: DESIGN_PLANNING_STALE; no provider or durable/projection side effect.
failureBehaviorMatrix.missingArchitectureApproval: DESIGN_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, or DESIGN_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW_STALE when its bindings are stale.
failureBehaviorMatrix.invalidWorkflowState: DESIGN_WORKFLOW_STATE_INVALID; generation is only available in AWAITING_DESIGN_SELECTION.
failureBehaviorMatrix.unapprovedRequirementChange: UNAPPROVED_REQUIREMENT_CHANGE; Design and selection remain blocked.
failureBehaviorMatrix.twoOrFourDirections: The existing DesignDirectionSetSchema and readiness validator reject counts other than exactly three.
failureBehaviorMatrix.wrongDirectionOrSet: The existing selection boundary rejects a non-current set or non-member direction with DESIGN_DIRECTION_NOT_FOUND.
failureBehaviorMatrix.wrongProjectOrVersion: The existing Design and Orchestrator boundaries reject mismatched project/version identity and stale currentness.
failureBehaviorMatrix.noSelection: No selection is persisted and the workflow does not become READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION.

filesOutsideLikelyFiles.scripts/phase-6c-cg02-verification.ts: Required shared verifier extension for current Design slices and the exact test-quality-reviewer and contract-auditor evidence pack.

correctionSummary: Added one focused deterministic contract-boundary regression covering stale Brief and Planning checksums, invalid workflow state, missing Architecture Review, and unapproved requirement changes. Each case proves rejection before provider and persistence/projection side effects. Extended the shared verifier with current Design gate, selection, and implementation-start evidence.
testsAdded: direct stale Brief checksum failure before side effects
direct stale Planning checksum failure before side effects
initialFailureReproduction: At baseline f3622d5, the Design suite passed 16 tests while no direct service-level evidence covered the assigned input-contract failure modes.
reviewExecutionEvidence: The shared verifier made two fresh structured-output calls against current Design contracts, Design input gate, implementation-start gate, and direct contract-failure tests; both returned APPROVED with valid evidence.

finding-bf13a0c6f16bf4702e9e.resolution: Recorded direct deterministic evidence for the implemented Design input-contract failure paths without changing their behavior.
